answer: Latency triangulation. Each epoch 20 validators on different continents ping every seat through a random inlet relay; light in fiber covers ~200 km per ms, so a seat's minimum round-trip vector pins it within a few hundred km. Seats whose vectors match within 2 ms sit in one lagoon of servers and merge into one vote. Delay can be padded but never removed, so no seat can fake a shorter voyage, and padding fails triangle-inequality checks. Fielding 200 distinct fakes means renting servers in 200 metros at ~$5/month, about $12k/yr, while an honest agent pays for one box.
